question: v1
asks: What total amount in USD of NVIDIA’s credit-support commitments and minimum-revenue guarantees or backstops to AI labs and cloud partners, including the support for the additional lab’s nearly 2 gigawatts of computing capacity, will be disclosed in NVIDIA’s FY2027 Form 10-K and related quantified disclosures by the annual report’s publication?
settles_on: The disclosed amount of guarantees, credit-support commitments and revenue backstops NVIDIA has extended to AI labs and cloud partners (including the credit support for nearly 2 gigawatts of computing capacity for one additional AI lab), versus the equity investments it has made, at NVIDIA's next annual report.

possible_answers.label: Neutral
possible_answers.holds_when: from 25,000,000,000 USD to below 50,000,000,000 USD (no reference figure when the question opened)

question: v2
asks: How much in purchase obligations and supply commitments will NVIDIA disclose in its FY2027 Form 10-K, as reported in the purchase obligations and contractual commitments disclosures and related notes?
settles_on: The amount of purchase obligations/supply commitments NVIDIA reports in its contractual obligations and purchase commitment disclosures in the Form 10-K, versus the prior year, given the analyst report that NVIDIA is taking on larger supply commitments.

possible_answers.label: Neutral
possible_answers.holds_when: from 100,000,000,000 USD to below 150,000,000,000 USD (no reference figure when the question opened)

question: v3
asks: By January 31, 2027, will U.S. authorities authorize Nvidia to sell Blackwell-generation AI chips to China and will Chinese authorities permit those shipments?
settles_on: Whether U.S. authorities extend export approval beyond the older H200 to Nvidia's current Blackwell-generation chips for approved Chinese customers, and whether Chinese authorities stop restricting Nvidia chip shipments, so that China data-center revenue can resume; the item reports H200 shipments are already U.S.-permitted while Chinese authorities still restrict them.

possible_answers.label: Yes
possible_answers.holds_when: By January 31, 2027, U.S. authorities have authorized sales of Nvidia Blackwell-generation AI chips to China and Chinese authorities permit those shipments.

possible_answers.label: Ruled out
possible_answers.holds_when: After September 23, 2026, U.S. export-control authorities formally prohibit Blackwell exports to China, or Chinese authorities formally prohibit Nvidia Blackwell shipments, with the prohibition remaining in force through January 31, 2027. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole, was made after 2026-09-23 and stands on 2027-01-31, and only when rung 1 does not.

possible_answers.label: Still open
possible_answers.holds_when: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2027-01-31.

question: v4
asks: Will NVIDIA disclose in its quarterly results or FY2027 Form 10-K that Vera Rubin made volume customer shipments with first revenue recognition by the end of FY2027 (January 31, 2027)?
settles_on: Whether Vera Rubin moves from full production to volume customer shipments and first revenue recognition within NVIDIA's fiscal 2027, as shown in the company's quarterly results and Form 10-K.

possible_answers.label: Yes
possible_answers.holds_when: NVIDIA's quarterly results or FY2027 Form 10-K show that Vera Rubin made volume customer shipments with first revenue recognition by January 31, 2027.

possible_answers.label: Ruled out
possible_answers.holds_when: After September 23, 2026, NVIDIA formally cancels or abandons the Vera Rubin platform before it makes volume customer shipments. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole, was made after 2026-09-23 and stands on 2027-01-31, and only when rung 1 does not.

possible_answers.label: Still open
possible_answers.holds_when: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2027-01-31.

question: v5
asks: How much will the five largest AI hyperscalers spend in total on data centers in calendar 2026, as shown by their Q4/full-year 2026 earnings and capex disclosures?
settles_on: The big five AI hyperscalers' combined calendar-2026 data center capital expenditure, compared with the nearly $800 billion the article says they will spend this year.

possible_answers.label: from 775,000,000,000 USD to below 825,000,000,000 USD
possible_answers.holds_when: from 775,000,000,000 USD to below 825,000,000,000 USD (the reference when the question opened: "the big five AI hyperscalers will spend nearly $800 billion on data centers this year")

question: v6
asks: Will NVIDIA complete (close) its agreed acquisition of Hugging Face, as disclosed in NVIDIA's filings, by March 24, 2028?
settles_on: Whether the agreed ~$12.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition is signed and closed (completed) as disclosed in NVIDIA's filings, versus being repriced, delayed past the check date or terminated.

possible_answers.label: Yes
possible_answers.holds_when: NVIDIA completes the Hugging Face acquisition by March 24, 2028, as evidenced by NVIDIA's filings or a completion announcement.

possible_answers.label: Ruled out
possible_answers.holds_when: After 2026-09-25, NVIDIA or Hugging Face formally terminates or withdraws the acquisition agreement before it is completed. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole, was made after 2026-09-25 and stands on 2028-03-24, and only when rung 1 does not.

possible_answers.label: Still open
possible_answers.holds_when: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2028-03-24.

question: v7
asks: Will China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) formally approve purchases of Nvidia's RTX Pro 5500 by Alibaba, ByteDance, or other Chinese firms by January 31, 2027?
settles_on: Whether MIIT moves from signaling intent and collecting purchase plans to actually approving Alibaba's, ByteDance's and other Chinese firms' purchases of the RTX Pro 5500 (versus blocking, delaying or capping quantities), so that Nvidia can ship the product into China and book related revenue.

possible_answers.label: Yes
possible_answers.holds_when: MIIT formally approves by January 31, 2027, a purchase of RTX Pro 5500 chips by Alibaba, ByteDance, or another Chinese firm.

possible_answers.label: Ruled out
possible_answers.holds_when: After September 27, 2026, MIIT formally rejects all RTX Pro 5500 purchase plans from Alibaba, ByteDance, and other Chinese firms, or formally prohibits those firms from purchasing the chips. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole, was made after 2026-09-27 and stands on 2027-01-31, and only when rung 1 does not.

possible_answers.label: Still open
possible_answers.holds_when: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2027-01-31.
